assertions: The Windows backend now implements bounded UI Automation application and semantic-tree discovery rather than refusing semantic actions after pixel capture.
Element references remain opaque, lease-scoped, revision-scoped, and invalidated after text mutation.
Text actions preserve Unicode character-offset semantics by reading the current value and inserting at the requested rune position.
All native commands remain session-bound, timeout-bounded, and fail closed when UI Automation or permissions are unavailable.
Semantic text actions compare the live ValuePattern value with the observed value before insertion, rejecting stale mutations.
Application catalogs are lease-bound and expire before a stale application reference can be reused.
Semantic resolution preserves the UI Automation traversal order for deterministic ambiguous-match results.
Semantic assertions invalidate their observation cache after the checked operation, preventing accidental reuse of an old control reference.
InvokeAction is accepted only with a helper-issued element ID and matching observation revision; attempted activation invalidates the semantic cache.
Windows invokes UI Automation InvokePattern, macOS invokes the retained System Events element, and AT-SPI invokes DoAction(0) after identity rechecks.
